description: Periodic snapshot emitted by mst-projector for one shard (typically one collection NSID). Phase 1 carries `snapshotHash` (sha-256 of the canonical-JSON record list) and `snapshotCid` (IPFS CID of the JSON manifest blob). Phase 2 replaces both with a true MST root CID. Per ADR-2605191358 step 5.

shardKey.description: Collection NSID this snapshot covers. e.g. `app.etzhayyim.murakumo.inferenceJobEvent`.

phase.description: Snapshot scheme version. 1 = JSON manifest + sha-256 root. 2 = CAR + true MST root (planned).

snapshotHash.description: Phase 1: sha256 of canonical-JSON record list (`sha256-<hex>`). Phase 2: dropped in favour of `rootCid`.

snapshotCid.description: IPFS CID (v1) of the manifest blob. Optional in Phase 1 if the daemon could not reach the IPFS pin endpoint; required in Phase 2.
